baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speakers promise obedience to revelation-averse interlocutors, restrict it to part of the matter, and are immediately placed under divine knowledge of concealment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negotiated speech converts aversion into a bounded compact: mutual accommodation gives another group a slice of decision-making, while concealment keeps the bargain from its excluded audience.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair makes the utterance function as a bargain rather than neutral reportage.
Active aversion supplies the receiving coalition's negative orientation toward what has been sent down.
Ordered placement makes revelation the arrangement whose proper position the compact resists.
Mutual accommodation turns promised obedience into coordination between two parties.
Partition into a part supplies the bargain's bounded jurisdiction.
Consultation and managed deliberation turn the matter into jointly planned policy.
Full cognition places the compact under an audit that its concealment cannot evade.
Interior concealment locates the bargain in a protected layer beneath its public setting.

changed_reading.before: A group simply promises limited obedience to people who dislike revelation.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts a negotiated covert compact: aversion is operationalized by ceding a bounded share of decision-making while the hidden coordination remains fully known.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction that joins obedience, a part, and the matter allows command and governing authority to be divided rather than merely reduced in quantity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The partitive phrase creates a jurisdictional compartment. The speakers do not transfer total allegiance; they admit a rival command into one sector, leaving their public and concealed loyalties structurally split.

activation_trace.role: Speech as an adopted position lets the pledge register alignment, not only a sentence.
Submission to an order supplies the transfer of practical allegiance.
A separated portion makes allegiance divisible into governed compartments.
Binding command gives the ceded compartment an imperative force.
Governance and office make the competing command a question of who exercises authority.
Hidden interiority holds the divided jurisdiction behind an outwardly undivided posture.

changed_reading.before: Some of the matter only narrows how much obedience is promised.
changed_reading.after: Partitivity creates a jurisdictional enclave: a rival authority is admitted into one compartment of allegiance, so selective obedience is itself a division of sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier use of part against part turns the focus partitive from a volume limiter into a relational operator. The secret compact can be read as a relay through which one faction's aversion acts inside another faction and exposes its allegiance under test.

activation_trace.role: Mutual accommodation supplies the interpersonal link through which influence is relayed.
A discrete part marks the bounded sector in which the relay operates.
Examination that reveals a condition turns inter-group pressure into a test of latent allegiance.
Parts set against other parts supply the social coupling that the focus compact can instantiate.

structural_cues: The earlier paired partitives place some people in an instrumental relation to others; the focus repeats the partitive inside a cross-group obedience pledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated partitivity, inter-group testing, and mutual compliance; I infer that the focus bargain is one relay of that test. A live alternative is that both uses are ordinary quantification with no shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Some merely limits the amount of obedience.
changed_reading.after: Some also marks a relay relation: one faction becomes the medium through which another faction's aversion acts and hidden loyalties are tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence contrasts requested revelation and acceptable obedience-language with the moment the affair becomes firm and must be fulfilled in action. The focus compact occupies that pressure point: public verbal compliance survives until a decisive command exposes a concealed competing obedience.

Repeated delivery makes the requested revelation an incoming directive whose cost will soon be tested.

Declared submission supplies the public posture against which the secret promise is measured.
Overtly produced speech isolates verbal correctness from later performance.
A resolved and cut-through intention marks the transition from speech to committed action.
Binding command identifies the action-threshold at which divided obedience becomes consequential.
Fulfillment of promise and deed supplies the criterion that speech alone fails to meet.
Repeated direct obedience fixes the legitimate axis that the partial rival pledge divides.
The messenger and message specify the authorized channel displaced by the covert compact.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from asking for revelation, to a firm directive, to acceptable speech, to truth in action, and later names the proper objects of obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the speech-to-action sequence and two competing obedience objects; I infer that the focus pledge is the concealed alternative activated at the decisive moment. It could instead be a limited bargain unrelated to that particular command test.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a bounded secret agreement.
changed_reading.after: It is selective obedience exposed at the action threshold: acceptable speech persists until a firm command requires fulfilled loyalty, where a hidden rival compact takes over part of the matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bounded concession is not necessarily a stable ceiling. In the surrounding sequence, divided loyalty can propagate through severed bonds, reversal after clarity, desire made attractive, active following, and the collapse of work; a small jurisdiction becomes a wedge with social and behavioral consequences.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each stage but not an explicit causal chain from one partial concession to all later effects; I supply that wedge-shaped arrow. A live alternative is that the focus reports an already mature alignment rather than its entry point.

changed_reading.after: Some may name an entry point rather than a safeguard: a compartment of rival obedience can widen into reversal, broken bonds, enacted following, and collapsed work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final knowledge clause becomes an exposure process rather than a static omniscience tag. Concealed hostility is brought outward, recognized by marks and verbal inflection, expressed in intentional work, and tested into reportable evidence.

Examination that reveals condition converts latent allegiance into tested knowledge.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden hostility, extraction, marks, inflected speech, deeds, tests, and reports; I supply the directional arrow that these are stages of one disclosure process. They may instead be parallel diagnostics rather than a temporal pipeline.

changed_reading.before: God privately knows a secret conversation.
changed_reading.after: The knowledge clause announces an evidentiary process: concealed hostility leaks into marks and verbal inflection, then is tested into reportable deeds; secrecy is latent behavior, not inert information.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late resource-pressure sequence gives the focus limit a material reading. Costly demand and persistent extraction draw concealed resistance outward; the pledge to obey only in some matters can therefore be a compliance ceiling that protects possessions and self-interest.

changed_reading.after: The limit may be cost-sensitive: compliance lasts through low-cost matters, while material pressure reaches a guarded reserve and brings concealed self-interest into action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus partitive's form-distant tiny-but-injurious branch. It remains anchored in the explicit part and gains a visible consequence from later severing and nullification; render it only as a scale-to-harm analogy, not as the lexical sense of the focus noun.

changed_reading.after: Smallness may be the danger: a minute conceded sector can injure bonds and drain effect from a much larger field of action.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a limited promise to a covert jurisdictional bargain that converts aversion into selective authority.
The speech-action sequence makes the compact a hidden alternative activated when a firm command demands fulfilled loyalty.
The knowledge clause became an exposure process in which concealed alignment leaks through marks, verbal contour, deeds, tests, and reports.
The partitive can function as a test relay or wedge, and under late resource pressure it can mark a cost-sensitive ceiling on compliance.
summary.what_was_special: Several readings remain live without merger: covert negotiation, divided sovereignty, inter-group testing, progressive reversal, evidentiary exposure, and resource protection. Form-distant branches additionally preserve small-but-harmful, projected-signal, settled-allegiance, and tactical-peace possibilities under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The content of some of the matter is not specified; tactical and financial models are contextual candidates, not identifications.
The causal movement from a partial concession to reversal, social fracture, or failed work is reader-supplied and could instead describe an already mature alignment.
The non-dominant and materially distant branches support analogies for projection, harm, and settlement, not replacement glosses.
